rule: agents flip only `passes`; red first, then green

features.rule: nothing sends unless every safety check passes; stop/takeover/no-contact/unknown-delivery/budget always win
features.test: send-authority unit + slop kill-switch: flip each hold mid-run -> 0 sends in 5 s

features.rule: unknown ledger state never retried, cost stays reserved
features.test: unit on model_ledger: inject unknown -> no second call, reservation intact; slop invariant unknown_retries == 0

features.rule: released refusal retries <=2 then human; 4xx -> human at once

features.test: slop inbox-storm variant: second message mid-draft -> first draft never delivered

features.rule: same fan/media id in two accounts shares nothing
features.test: slop seed two accounts with same fan + media id -> no shared context/price/purchase/job rows (SQL)

features.rule: migrations additive, downgrade refuses to destroy, head pins consistent
features.test: CI: alembic upgrade head on empty PG + downgrade one step refuses; schema.py HEAD == alembic head; pin test

features.rule: manual category prices only; uncertain -> Miscellaneous, unsellable
features.test: unit: no price without operator row; unknown category -> unsellable
unit: item outside window with purchase evidence stays owned; missing evidence -> unknown

features.rule: singles + approved bundles only; bundle excluded if any paid item owned; no invented discounts/stacking/repricing of sent cards
features.test: unit matrix on card builder; slop invariant price_changes_after_send == 0
reply validator: outbound tip-request text -> rejected

features.rule: staff messages are context, never approval/purchase; new context cancels stale AI work
features.test: unit: staff message -> no approval row; pending AI draft cancelled

features.rule: no customs, physical goods, external access, timed packages
no OF credentials/cookies in logs or fixtures
